title: Vite config in wrong directory breaks build tooling
reasoning: The vite.config.ts file is located in src/ instead of the project root. Vite looks for vite.config.ts in the project root by default. The package.json scripts run 'vite' without specifying a config path, so they will fail to find the config file. The outDir: '../dist' confirms the config expects to be in src/ (going up one level to reach dist), which is non-standard. This will cause all build commands to fail or use default Vite configuration instead of the intended React plugin and build settings.
reproduction: Run 'npm run build' or 'npm run dev' from the project root. Vite will either fail to find the config or use default settings, missing the React plugin configuration.
recommendation: Move vite.config.ts from src/ to the project root, and change outDir from '../dist' to 'dist'. Alternatively, update package.json scripts to specify the config location: 'vite --config src/vite.config.ts'.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included in this feature. Build configuration issues are typically caught during CI/CD or manual testing, not unit tests.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a CI check that runs 'npm run build' and verifies the output exists in dist/ with expected React build artifacts. Alternatively, add a basic smoke test that imports the vite config and validates it resolves correctly.
minimumFixScope: Move src/vite.config.ts to ./vite.config.ts and update outDir to 'dist', or update all three package.json script commands to include '--config src/vite.config.ts'.
